say:1:1130308001:1.text: It may sound this way, but I am not. I am communicating.
say:1:1130308001:1.source_cn: 听起来可能是这样，但实际上并不是，我是在交流。
say:1:1130308001:1.male: It may sound this way, but I am not. I am communicating.
say:1:1130308001:1.female: It may sound this way, but I am not. I am communicating.

say:2:1130308002:1.text: I listen to the sounds of the desert and converse with distant souls.
say:2:1130308002:1.source_cn: 我在聆听沙漠的声音，在和远方的灵魂交流。
say:2:1130308002:1.male: I listen to the sounds of the desert and converse with distant souls.
say:2:1130308002:1.female: I listen to the sounds of the desert and converse with distant souls.

say:3:1130308003:1.text: Can you hear them? Their voices?
say:3:1130308003:1.source_cn: 你能听到吗？他们的声音。
say:3:1130308003:1.male: Can you hear them? Their voices?
say:3:1130308003:1.female: Can you hear them? Their voices?

choice_prompt:4:1130308003.text: Can you hear them? Their voices?
choice_prompt:4:1130308003.source_cn: 你能听到吗？他们的声音。
choice_prompt:4:1130308003.male: Can you hear them? Their voices?
choice_prompt:4:1130308003.female: Can you hear them? Their voices?

say:5:1130308004:1.text: It seems you cannot hear them. Pity.
say:5:1130308004:1.source_cn: 看来你是听不到了，真是太可惜了。
say:5:1130308004:1.male: It seems you cannot hear them. Pity.
say:5:1130308004:1.female: It seems you cannot hear them. Pity.

say:6:1130308005:1.text: They speak of the weather. Today there was heavy rain in the desert, a rare occurrence.
say:6:1130308005:1.source_cn: 他们在说……在说天气的事情，今天沙漠罕见地下起了大雨。
say:6:1130308005:1.male: They speak of the weather. Today there was heavy rain in the desert, a rare occurrence.
say:6:1130308005:1.female: They speak of the weather. Today there was heavy rain in the desert, a rare occurrence.

say:7:1130308006:1.text: The rain travels steadily. It will reach us soon enough.
say:7:1130308006:1.source_cn: 这场雨会一直往一个方向移动，相信不久就会来到我们这里。
say:7:1130308006:1.male: The rain travels steadily. It will reach us soon enough.
say:7:1130308006:1.female: The rain travels steadily. It will reach us soon enough.

say:8:1130308007:1.text: Beware and heed these messages. The souls of the desert have spoken.
say:8:1130308007:1.source_cn: 所以，你们也要小心，这是来自灵魂的忠告。
say:8:1130308007:1.male: Beware and heed these messages. The souls of the desert have spoken.
say:8:1130308007:1.female: Beware and heed these messages. The souls of the desert have spoken.
